The simulated FM-1 is for trying the app without one.

If the FM-1 won\'t start at all, not even in USB recovery mode, FM-SWITCH can\'t help, but a computer usually can. M-Flasher, for Mac, Windows and Linux, backs up and reinstalls the FM-1 through its chip\'s own download mode, which works even when the firmware is broken: an FM-1 whose firmware is damaged often starts in that mode by itself. The firmware hub keeps a list of rescue tools, M-Flasher among them, with others for an FM-1 that doesn\'t get that far. FM-SWITCH hasn\'t tried any of these.
